jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer I
jobs.description:
Requistion ID
: 84165

Dentsply Sirona ist der weltweit größte Anbieter von Dentalprodukten und -technologien und kann auf mehr als ein Jahrhundert an Innovationen und Dienstleistungen für die Dentalindustrie und Patienten weltweit zurückblicken. Dentsply Sirona entwickelt, produziert und vermarktet ein umfassendes Lösungsangebot, das Produkte für die Zahn- und Mundgesundheit sowie andere medizinische Verbrauchsgüter unter einem starken Portfolio von Weltklassemarken umfasst.

Die Produkte von Dentsply Sirona bieten innovative, qualitativ hochwertige und effektive Lösungen, um die Patientenversorgung zu verbessern und eine bessere und sicherere zahnmedizinische Versorgung zu gewährleisten. Der Hauptsitz von Dentsply Sirona befindet sich in Charlotte, North Carolina. Die Aktien des Unternehmens sind in den Vereinigten Staaten an der NASDAQ unter dem Symbol XRAY notiert. Besuchen Sie www.dentsplysirona.com für weitere Informationen über Dentsply Sirona und seine Produkte.

Wir suchen einen Senior Software Engineer I (m/w/d), der unser Team verstärkt.
In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Leitung bei der Entwicklung und Architektur komplexer Systeme und stellen deren Skalierbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sicher. Sie arbeiten über mehrere Epics hinweg, koordinieren Features und etablieren einheitliche Refinement-Prozesse über verschiedene Teams hinweg. Dies ist eine Hybrid-Position, die eine Anwesenheit im Büro von mindestens einem Tag pro Woche erfordert.

Ihre Aufgaben

Technische Umsetzung & Entwicklung

Fördern Sie die bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zwischen Product-, UX- und Infrastruktur-Teams.
Unterstützen und coachen Sie Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler teamübergreifend als technischer Mentor und Berater.
Führen Sie neue Technologien ein und treiben deren Nutzung voran, um die Effizienz der Softwareentwicklung zu steigern.
Übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für Incident-Response-Prozesse und sorgen Sie für die Ausfallsicherheit der Systeme.

Projektumfang & Komplexität

Leiten Sie die Umsetzung über mehrere Epics hinweg und koordinieren Sie verschiedene Features, um ein konsistentes Refinement sicherzustellen.
Steuern und begleiten Sie den Epic-Refinement-Prozess zur effektiven Abstimmung mehrerer Features über unterschiedliche Teams hinweg.

Kommunikation & Wirkung

Präsentieren Sie komplexe technische Strategien gegenüber unterschiedlichen Stakeholder-Gruppen.
Fördern Sie die Abstimmung und Einigkeit bei technischen Entscheidungen über mehrere Teams hinweg.

Führung & Weiterentwicklung

Bieten Sie unternehmensweite technische Unterstützung und Mentoring.
Geben Sie die architektonische Ausrichtung vor und unterstützen Sie wichtige technische Entscheidungen.

Ihr Profil

Ausbildung

Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Physik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet beziehungsweise eine gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

Berufserfahrung & Qualifikationen

4 bis 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung.
Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer technischer Projekte über mehrere Teams hinweg.
Erfahrung mit mehreren Programmiersprachen wie Golang, C++ oder Flutter/Dart.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Systemarchitektur sowie Skalierbarkeit von Softwarelösungen.
Erfahrung im Mentoring von Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern über verschiedene Teams hinweg.
Erfahrung mit verteilten Systemen (Distributed Systems).
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung technischer Strategien ist von Vorteil.
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Medizinprodukten ist ein Plus.
Nachweisbare Erfolge bei Architekturentscheidungen sind wünschenswert.

Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert:
Dentsply Sirona ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Alle qualifizierten Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden berücksichtigt, ohne Diskriminierung oder Rücksicht auf Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, sexuelle oder geschlechtliche Identität, nationale oder ethnische Herkunft, Alter, Familienstand, Behinderung, genetische Merkmale, Militär- und Veteranenstatus oder andere durch geltendes lokales Recht geschützte Merkmale.

Arbeitsberechtigung:
Alle erfolgreichen Bewerberinnen und Bewerber müssen berechtigt sein, in dem Land zu arbeiten, in dem die Stelle angesiedelt ist.

Unterstützung bei der Bewerbung:
Wenn Sie aufgrund einer Behinderung Hilfe beim Ausfüllen der Online-Bewerbung benötigen, senden Sie bitte eine entsprechende Nachricht an accommodationrequest@dentsplysirona.com.

Agenturen:
Bitte beachten Sie, dass Dentsply Sirona keine unaufgeforderten Anfragen oder Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlungsagenturen/ Personalberatungsfirmen akzeptiert oder beantwortet.

Hinweis zu betrügerischen Stellenangeboten:
Leider ist uns bekannt, dass Dritte, die vorgeben, unser Unternehmen zu vertreten, nicht genehmigte Stellenangebote anbieten. Wenn Sie glauben, dass eine betrügerische Quelle Ihnen eine Stelle anbietet, sehen Sie sich bitte die folgenden Informationen an: careers.dentsplysirona.com.

jobs.description:
Möchten Sie als Softwareentwickler an der technologischen Basis einer modernen Gesamtbanksteuerung mitwirken? Für ein renommierte Förderbank mit Sitz in München, suchen wir Verstärkung für die Softwareentwicklung, Schnittstellenbetreuung und Konzeption im zentralen RISK/CONT-System.

Start: 01.01.2027
Laufzeit: 12 Monate (Gesamtprojektlaufzeit ca. 3 Jahre)
Auslastung: 140 Beratertage pro Jahr (Auslastung ca. 70 %)
Einsatzort: München / ca. 98 % Remote
Max. Tagessatz: 840,00 € all in.

Hinweis für Ihre Bewerbung: Bitte fügen Sie Ihren Unterlagen eine ausgefüllte Skillmatrix bei, aus der die genannten Mindesterfahrungen in Ihren bisherigen Projekten klar hervorgehen. Vielen Dank

Softwareentwicklung & Systembetreuung: Technische Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung des zentralen RISK/CONT-Systems zur Abbildung von Aktiv-/Passiv-Steuerung, Betriebswirtschaft, Controlling sowie Risiko-Controlling in PL/SQL (Open Text Team Developer), ABAP und C#
Schnittstellenprogrammierung: Konzeption und Implementierung robuster Schnittstellen für die Datenversorgung aus operativen Systemen und die Datenlieferung an dispositive Systeme
Anforderungsanalyse & Aufwandsschätzung: Klärung und Abstimmung fachlicher und IT-seitiger Anforderungen mit den Fachbereichen sowie Erstellung fundierter Aufwandsschätzungen
Konzeption: Erstellung und Detaillierung von Fach-, DV- und Testkonzepten
Betrieb & Support: Durchführen von Fehleranalysen, Behebung von Störungen im produktiven Betrieb sowie technische System- und Prozessdokumentation
Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Gesamtbanksteuerung
Mindestens 4 Jahre vertiefte Praxis in der Softwareentwicklung mit PL/SQL, SQLWindows (Open Text Team Developer) und ABAP inkl. den zugehörigen integrierten Entwicklungsumgebungen
Mindestens 4 Jahre nachweisbare Erfahrung im Betrieb banktechnischer IT-Prozesse
Projekterfahrung im (Förder-)Bankenumfeld
Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Schnittstellenarchitektur, Testdurchführung sowie in der Erstellung technischer und fachlicher Dokumentationen
Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Keine zeitraubende Rechnungserstellung mehr nötig
Schnelle, zuverlässige Honorarzahlung
Projektverträge mittels elektronischer Signatur abschließen

jobs.description:
Du verstehst Kundenanforderungen nicht nur technisch, sondern denkst sie konsequent bis in den Betrieb zu Ende?

Als PreSales Solution Architect (m/w/d)
gestaltest du gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Azure-basierte Managed-Services-Lösungen. Dabei sorgst du dafür, dass diese von Anfang an sauber in unser Betriebsmodell überführt werden können und agierst als technisches Bindeglied zwischen Vertrieb, Entwicklung und Operations.

Was du bei uns machst

Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen im PreSales-Prozess und übersetzt sie in passende Managed-Service-Lösungen auf Basis von Azure PaaS-, IaaS- und Container-Diensten.
Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit den Service-Operations-Teams das konkrete Betriebsmodell für neue Kundenlösungen: inklusive Betriebsverantwortung, SLAs, Automatisierungsgrad und Schnittstellen.
Du erstellst technische Lösungskonzepte, Aufwandsschätzungen und Betriebsannahmen als Grundlage für Angebote und Business Cases.
Du begleitest Kundengespräche und Workshops, moderierst technische Anforderungsklärung und präsentierst Lösungsvorschläge verständlich auf Entscheiderebene.
Du sorgst für eine strukturierte Übergabe von PreSales an Delivery und Operations.
Du bringst dich aktiv in Weiterentwicklung unseres Managed-Services-Portfolios ein.
Du berätst Kunden zu Sicherheit, Skalierung, Verfügbarkeit und Betriebskosten ihrer Azure-Umgebungen im Kontext eines Managed-Service-Betriebs.

Wann du zu uns passt

Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Architekturdesign mit Azure PaaS-, IaaS- und Container-Diensten und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung im Betrieb solcher Umgebungen mit.
Du hast Erfahrung in der Übersetzung von Kundenanforderungen in technische Architekturen sowie in Betriebsmodelle und Servicekonzepte.
Du bringst Erfahrung in der Kundenberatung zu Azure-Diensten hinsichtlich Funktionalität, Sicherheit, Skalierung und Betriebszeit mit.
Du bist mit den Grundlagen von Managed Services wie SLAs, Betriebsprozessen, Serviceleveln, Automatisierung und ITSM vertraut.
Du bist mit Azure DevOps, automatisierten Pipelines und Infrastructure as Code sowie deren Bedeutung für einen standardisierten Betrieb vertraut.
Du bist in der Lage, technische PreSales-Meetings zu leiten und Lösungen verständlich gegenüber Kunden und intern zu präsentieren.
Du verstehst dich als Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Entwicklung und Operations.
Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse und kannst sicher auf Englisch kommunizieren.

PoCs and MVPs in AI transformation projects inside enterprise ERP software - rapid exploration of new capabilities, with the engineering discipline to evolve the successful ones into production-grade services.
Cloud platform services - designing and building the services, APIs, and data layers that new AI capabilities run on, integrating with large, established ERP products.
Production readiness - bringing R&D output up to enterprise standard: reliability, observability, security, multi-tenancy, and safe failure behaviour.
AI engineering - integrating LLMs and agentic patterns into business software responsibly: guardrails, permissions, auditability, and designing for the probabilistic nature of AI components acting on real business data.
Raising the bar - architectural review across the team's workstreams, mentoring engineers at all levels, and turning good judgement into standards and automation rather than tribal knowledge.

What You Are Likely To Bring

Principal-level engineering depth in C#/.NET and/or Python, with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), and a strong record of designing and shipping production services. Our systems span both stacks - strength in one with working fluency in the other is the expectation.
Production TypeScript/JavaScript frontend engineering experience, including building secure, accessible user interfaces that integrate with enterprise web shells, APIs and backend services.
Experience designing and integrating enterprise information systems, with a strong understanding of data flows, system boundaries and the operational impact of change.
Ability to work effectively with data scientists and other AI specialists to turn data, models and experimentation into reliable, usable product capabilities.
Production ownership experience - you have run systems in production and carry the instincts that come from it: partial failure, resilience, blast-radius thinking, and designing for the incident nobody planned. This matters to us more than any specific framework.
Distributed-systems fluency: service boundaries, transactional thinking, multi-tenant design, API design and versioning.
Strong architectural communication - able to explain, document, and defend design decisions across teams, and to review others' designs constructively.
Pragmatism under real-world constraints: comfortable integrating with large, long-lived enterprise systems and choosing the achievable-good over the theoretical-perfect.

Highly Desirable

Hands-on exposure to AI-assisted engineering - building with LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, and prompt-driven workflows, and a grounded view of where they help and where they don't.
Experience taking early-stage products (PoC/MVP) to production, ideally in enterprise software.
AWS experience.
Complex business-domain experience - ERP, e-commerce, finance, logistics - and an appreciation of the cost of getting business data wrong.
Security instincts: least privilege, tenancy isolation, trust boundaries.

Deliver production-quality code
Own components from design through implementation
Contribute architectural improvements across the team

Lead the design of major platform capabilities
Become a trusted technical leader and architectural reference point

Our team explores new ideas, rapidly prototypes solutions, and turns successful concepts into production-ready capabilities before handing them over to product engineering teams.

From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Location(s): London or Manchester

BAE Systems Digital Intelligence is home to 4,500 digital, cyber and intelligence experts. We work collaboratively across 10 countries to collect, connect and understand complex data, so that governments, nation states, armed forces and commercial businesses can unlock digital advantage in the most demanding environments.

Job Title: Software Engineer

Requistion ID: 120492

Location: London, Manchester or Leeds – Hybrid working offered, with consideration for both full and part-time applicants – please speak to your recruiter about the options

Grade: GG08 – GG13

Are you passionate about working with cutting-edge technology and self-motivated to find innovative solutions to complex challenges as part of a team who help keep the UK safe? Join BAE Systems as an experienced Software Engineer.

As a key member of a Software Engineering team, you’ll be working with our National Security Customers to build systems that support their core mission capabilities. You’ll work as part of empowered, autonomous DevOps teams with regular contact with end-users to flexibly and efficiently understand, design, develop, deploy and maintain applications and services. You’ll be encouraged to identify new ways of solving problems and get to work in a range of different teams across our customer organisations. You’ll be part of the biggest defence company in the UK however we have a startup-like culture nurtured by sports and social clubs, being a safe place to fail, meaning and self-fulfilment over business, and learning from our partners, suppliers, and peers.

We fully embrace DevOps ways of working in our teams, and build a very broad range of capabilities for our customers. We therefore value Engineers who enjoy playing a role in the full delivery lifecycle and are flexible to learn and pick up new technologies and approaches. You’ll be playing a role in identifying the right technologies to use for the job and be supported with training as needed through access to services such as Pluralsight.

Not only will your team be directly making a huge impact upon the systems you work on, you’ll be doing it for an organisation who makes a huge impact to the security of the UK.

About You

You will have experience in many of the following:

Programming in one or more of JavaScript, Java, .Net, Python
Collaboratively designing and building Proof of Concept or Production systems
Source controlling your code with Version Control Systems, for example Git, Mercurial, Perforce
Utilising CI/CD tools, such as Bamboo, Jenkins, TeamCity, Bitbucket, in order to streamline delivery of new features and fixes
Continual testing of code using Automated Testing Frameworks
Ensuring code consistency and quality by utilising static code analysis tools e.g. SonarQube
Team working inside an agile environment e.g. Scrum, Lean, Kanban
Common software design patterns
Using precedent and your own creativity to solve our client's challenges!

It would be great if you also had experience in some of these, but if not we’ll help you with them

Machine Learning software e.g. Amazon and Azure machine learning, or Google's TensorFlow
Deploying and managing in Cloud Computing such as AWS, MS Azure
Containerisation e.g. Docker, Kubernetes
Relational, document, or graph database systems
Software configuration and deployment e.g. Ansible

Security Clearance

Due to the nature of our work, successful candidates for this role will be required to hold an active eDV before applying for this opportunity.

How We Will Support You

Work-life balance is important; you can work around core hours with flexible and part-time working, and many of our roles include hybrid working enabling a mix of working from home and in the office
You’ll get 25 days holiday a year and the option to buy/sell and carry over from the year before
Our flexible benefits package includes private medical and dental insurance, a competitive pension scheme, cycle to work scheme, taste cards and more
You’ll have a dedicated Career Manager to help you develop your career and guide you on your journey through BAE
You’ll be part of our company bonus scheme
You are welcome to join any/all of our Employee Resource groups. These groups cover everything from gender diversity to mental health and wellbeing.

About Our Team

Our people are what differentiates us, they are resourceful, innovative and dedicated. We have a mix of generalists and specialists and recognise that this diversity contributes to our success. We recognise the benefits of forming teams from a mix of disciplines, which allows us to come up with cutting edge, high quality solutions. Our breadth of work across the Public Sector provides diverse opportunities for our people to develop their careers in new areas of expertise and with new clients.

You’ll be part of a big company, but we try to create a culture that feels like a small one. The work will stretch you and be challenging, but we encourage a healthy work-life balance. Most of all, we know teams who work well together also perform well. We’ll do everything we can to ensure you have fun at work, and in social activities outside of it whether that’s virtually or in person, as conditions allow.

We have a rich history of working within National Security. In fact, we have over 40 years’ experience of delivering advice and solutions to our customers in this sector, supporting them in carrying out their vital missions.

Why BAE Systems?

This is a place where you’ll be able to make a real difference. You’ll be part of an inclusive culture that values diversity of thought, rewards integrity, and merit, and where you’ll be empowered to fulfil your potential. We welcome people from all backgrounds and want to make sure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible. If you have a disability or health condition (for example dyslexia, autism, an anxiety disorder etc.) that may affect your performance in certain assessment types, please speak to your recruiter about potential reasonable adjustments.

Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation. All applicants must as a minimum achieve Baseline Personnel Security Standard. Many roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting where applicants must typically have 5 to 10 years of continuous residency in the UK depending on the vetting level required for the role, to allow for meaningful security vetting checks.

Life at BAE Systems Digital Intelligence

We are embracing Hybrid Working. This means you and your colleagues may be working in different locations, such as from home, another BAE Systems office or client site, some or all of the time, and work might be going on at different times of the day.

By embracing technology, we can interact, collaborate and create together, even when we’re working remotely from one another. Hybrid Working allows for increased flexibility in when and where we work, helping us to balance our work and personal life more effectively, and enhance well-being.

Inclusion is integral to the success of BAE Systems Digital Intelligence. We are proud to have an organisational culture where employees with varying perspectives, skills, life experiences and backgrounds – the best and brightest minds – can work together to achieve excellence and realise individual and organisational potential.

Division overview: Capabilities

At BAE Systems Digital Intelligence, we pride ourselves in being a leader in the cyber defence industry, and Capabilities is the engine that keeps the business moving forward. It is the largest area of Digital Intelligence, containing our Engineering, Consulting and Project Management teams that design and implement the defence solutions and digital transformation projects that make us a globally recognised brand in both the public and private sector.

As a member of the Capabilities team, you will be creating and managing the solutions that earn us our place in an ever changing digital world. We all have a role to play in defending our clients, and this is yours.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering - Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns (Manchester)
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Engineering – Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns

Fitch Ratings

The Opportunity

Fitch Ratings is looking for a builder, a challenger, and a boundary-pusher to lead the engineering organization responsible for all applications and services powering our Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns lines of business. This is not a role for someone who optimizes within the status quo — it's a role for someone who questions it, reimagines it, and has the courage and capability to do something about it.

As Senior Director, you will have executive ownership of four engineering teams comprising a couple of dozen engineers. You'll lead a talented, multidisciplinary group tackling some of the most consequential technology challenges in global financial intelligence — maintaining and evolving the systems that analysts and clients depend on today, while simultaneously building the next generation of platforms from a position of real creative freedom and organizational backing.

This is a role for someone who moves fast, experiments boldly, and doesn't wait for permission to try something new. Someone who has broken things in the pursuit of building something better, who sees constraints as invitations to be clever, and who brings an infectious sense of possibility that raises the ambition of everyone around them. If you've spent time deep in machine learning or AI systems — not just using them, but building them — that's not just a bonus, it's the kind of background that makes this opportunity even more compelling. But this role goes far beyond any single discipline: it's about leading a culture of relentless innovation across every dimension of how software gets built and delivered.

We'll Count on You To

Challenge the conventional and set a bolder technical vision
Own the strategic direction, execution, and engineering culture of four high-performing full-stack engineering teams. But more than managing what exists — interrogate it. Ask the uncomfortable questions about why things are built the way they are, and lead your teams toward answers that are smarter, faster, and more powerful. Set a technical vision that doesn't just improve the current state but genuinely reimagines what's possible for the platforms powering Fitch's most critical analytical work.

Build, develop, and inspire exceptional people
Lead, mentor, and empower a team of team leads and engineers across a range of technical backgrounds and experience levels. Foster a culture where intellectual curiosity is celebrated, where experimentation is encouraged, and where people feel safe enough to take risks and learn loudly from what doesn't work. Attract and retain engineers who are hungry, inventive, and proud of both the quality of what they ship today and the audacity of what they're building toward.

Reimagine and modernize critical platforms
Oversee the full lifecycle of the applications and services central to Fitch's Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns analytical workflows. Balance the discipline of maintaining production-grade systems with the creative ambition to tear down and rebuild what no longer serves the business well. Be the person in the room who asks "what if we started over?" — and who knows when that's exactly the right call.

Drive greenfield innovation without apology
Identify and actively pursue opportunities to design and build net-new applications and platforms that replace or leapfrog legacy approaches. Embrace the blank canvas — and bring the rigor of world-class software delivery with you. This is an organization that wants to see bets placed, experiments run, and lessons learned fast. Be the kind of leader who creates that energy and channels it into things that last.

Push the frontier of AI, ML, and intelligent systems
Go beyond adopting AI tools — define how intelligent systems become structural, load-bearing parts of the platforms your teams own. Whether that's LLM-powered workflows, ML models embedded in analytical processes, agentic automation, or AI-augmented developer tooling, bring the depth to evaluate, architect, and champion these capabilities with real technical conviction. If you've built ML systems from the ground up, that experience will resonate deeply here — and you'll have the platform to apply it in genuinely high-stakes, high-visibility ways.

Influence across a complex and interconnected stakeholder landscape
Act as a strategic partner to a broad and diverse set of stakeholders — including senior leadership, analytical teams, operations, and business relationship management — whose workflows and outcomes depend directly on the platforms your teams own. Navigate a rich ecosystem of technical interdependencies, partnering with peer engineering teams whose systems integrate with, depend on, or are shaped by what your teams build. Build organizational credibility through consistent delivery, clear technical vision, and the ability to bring bold ideas to life in ways that earn trust across the business.

What You Need To Have

18+ years of hands-on software engineering experience , with substantial time in senior technical leadership roles overseeing multiple teams and disciplines
Proven multi-team leadership — demonstrated experience leading team leads and engineers across full-stack disciplines; a track record of building high-performing, inventive engineering cultures at meaningful scale
Deep technical credibility and hands-on instinct — strong command of modern software architecture, cloud-native platforms, and production-grade application delivery; you know when to go deep, and your teams and peers will know it too
Full-stack engineering expertise — proven background with modern enterprise technology stacks, including React, Java, and/or Python in production environments, deployed across AWS and/or Azure
A bias for experimentation and innovation — a demonstrable history of pushing technical boundaries, challenging inherited assumptions, and driving teams toward approaches that are meaningfully better — not just incrementally improved
Modernization and greenfield experience — proven ability to evolve existing platforms while simultaneously designing and delivering new systems; comfort making bold architectural decisions in both constrained legacy and open greenfield environments
People leadership and talent development — demonstrated ability to attract, grow, and retain exceptional engineers and engineering leaders; a builder of teams as much as systems, with a genuine investment in the growth of the people around you
Cross-functional stakeholder management — proven ability to partner effectively across analytical, operational, and business-facing teams as well as peer technical organizations; skilled at managing competing priorities and driving alignment across a complex interdependency landscape
Executive communication — the ability to translate bold technical vision for non-technical audiences, build trust through delivery, and make complex ideas land clearly at every level of the organization
Education: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent expertise demonstrated through impact

What Would Make You Stand Out

An ML or AI engineering background — if you've spent meaningful time building machine learning systems, training models, designing intelligent pipelines, or architecting AI-native applications, that depth is genuinely exciting for this role and will shape how you lead, what you build, and the kind of talent you attract
Deep cloud-native expertise — hands-on mastery of AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, microservices architecture, and sophisticated CI/CD and deployment pipelines for large-scale application delivery
Generative AI and intelligent systems experience — hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, or production ML systems; the ability to move between engineering credibility and strategic vision without losing altitude
AI-native delivery leadership — direct experience implementing AI-augmented development lifecycles, intelligent testing pipelines, or AI-assisted tooling that materially raises the quality and velocity of engineering teams
Transformation and platform modernization leadership — a history of successfully reimagining complex, production-critical platforms while maintaining delivery continuity and rallying teams around a compelling future state
A maverick streak with enterprise judgment — the rare combination of someone who genuinely challenges conventions and moves with urgency, but knows how to do it within a complex organization without losing stakeholders along the way
Financial services domain knowledge — familiarity with analytical workflows, credit ratings processes, or how technology creates leverage in financial decision-making
Technical thought leadership — contributing to open source, speaking at industry events, publishing engineering content, or establishing technical direction that influences well beyond your immediate team

What We Offer

A genuine mandate to innovate — not a talking point, but real organizational backing to question, challenge, and rebuild the platforms powering some of Fitch's most critical business lines
Executive visibility and strategic influence — direct access to senior leadership, the platform to shape engineering direction across consequential lines of business, and the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on how global financial intelligence is delivered
The intersection of depth and breadth — lead a capable, experienced engineering organization while simultaneously running a bold innovation agenda; this role sits at a genuinely rare intersection of operational accountability and creative freedom
A place where ML and AI expertise becomes architecture — if you've built intelligent systems, this is an environment where that knowledge doesn't sit on the shelf; it shapes product direction, platform design, and how the organization thinks about what's next
Cutting-edge technology and continuous learning — access to the latest AI tools, frameworks, platforms; training and conference budgets; and the expectation that you'll stay at the leading edge and pull your teams forward with you
Career acceleration at scale — high visibility to the most senior leaders at Fitch, a clear path to principal and executive roles, and the opportunity to define what AI-driven financial technology looks like in practice
A culture that rewards curiosity — an environment where bold ideas are welcomed, where experimentation is celebrated, and where the best thinking wins regardless of where it comes from

Why Fitch?

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.

Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

About Fitch Group

Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning.

For more information please visit our websites: www.fitchratings.com | www.fitchsolutions.com | www.fitchlearning.com

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. jobs.description:
Job Description

Division: Group Business Solutions (GBS)

Your career opportunity

Join our Group Business Solutions (GBS) division, where we design and sustain IT solutions for financial market securities. Be part of a dynamic, collaborative team in a fast-evolving environment, shaping the future of financial technology.
Ready to make an impact?

We’re seeking a skilled and proactive Expert Engineer eager to broaden their expertise and drive impactful improvements across our solutions. You’ll tackle complex problems and help shape our delivery, working in a collaborative environment that supports growth, fosters innovation and strengthens our alignment with business needs.
Your Day-to-day Mission

Lead the design, architecture, and development of technical and functional solutions, owning complex features and collaborating with senior developers and cross‑functional teams to deliver robust, scalable systems. Provide expert input to technical decisions and support junior colleagues in resolving medium‑to‑high‑complexity issues.
Contribute and actively shape ideation workshops by providing expert insights and recommending enhancements to improve product functionality and user experience
Drive the definition, estimation, and validation of complex technical requirements, proactively influencing planning accuracy and enabling predictable, high‑quality feature delivery across teams.
Ensure the stability and reliability of production applications by independently leading technical investigations, implementing durable fixes, and guiding peers in troubleshooting.
Lead the creation and improvement of design documentation for medium‑to‑high‑complexity changes, ensuring technical clarity and alignment with architectural standards while contributing to stronger design practices across the team.
Drive the adoption and evolution of best practices and coding standards to ensure high code quality, while leading and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the team.
Take ownership of applications (quality, support, evolution)
Perform production support (including off-hours when required)

What you need to have to succeed in this role:

Hands-on experience as a software engineer (at least 5 years) .
Advanced understanding of software related system designs and technology stacks.
Solid knowledge of solution development and design principles.
Ability to interpret business requirements, assess their technical implications, and help translate them into well‑scoped, practical technical solutions.
Proactive in learning and expanding technical expertise, while contributing to team goals, engaging in cross‑functional projects, and supporting cloud migration efforts, AI integration, automation frameworks, Infrastructure as Code best practices and effective collaboration within and across teams
Strong command of English, both spoken and written.
Hands-on experience with tools/platforms such as:
Mainframe: PL/I or Cobol, DB2, MQ, CICS
Nice to have:
Java / .NET / APIs / Integration
Azure, Kafka, event-driven architecture
IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, JDK, Javac/Java commands, Maven, Gradle, IDE environments, JUnit, Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, VisualVM, JFR, Kubernetes, Azure Cloud, AWS, GCP, VPC/VNet, CLI, Visual Studio, Oracle, CSS, SSIS, APIs, MQ Series, Linux, Togaf, CoBit.

What Makes You Stand Out

Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities
A strong sense of ownership and accountability in your work
Proactive attitude with a structured and solution-oriented approach Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Ability to collaborate effectively in a multicultural environment
Clear and effective communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Coaching and mentoring capabilities, with a willingness to support team growth
A continuous learning mindset and drive for improvement  Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities
Knowledge of Agile methodologies.

Work outside of business hours is sometimes required as launches in production are generally carried out after 5PM or on Saturday as well as watch duty during nights and weekends.

Please note that this is a permanent position, and we do not offer freelance or contract arrangements for this role.

About Us

Why join us

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.
What We Offer

Work closely with inspiring, supportive and engaged colleagues from more than 80 different countries.
Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Join a learning and development environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

Ways of working

Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.
Great Place to Work for All

We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity and strives to be a Great Place to Work for All. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment, regardless of any aspect that makes them unique (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, disability, ...). If you need any specific accommodation due to disability or any other reason, you can let the recruiter know during your application process. Our values guide how we work together and shape our future: Our mission and values - Euroclear
About The Team

The Group Business Solutions (GBS) division ensures the competitiveness of Euroclear by delivering reliable and sustainable IT solutions for the financial securities markets. Our technical teams deliver new IT solutions and improve existing applications for both our internal and external clients. We deploy changes into the production environment in a controlled and structured way that doesn't compromise production stability and we ensure applicative production support.

jobs.title: Citizen Developer AI & Power Platforms
jobs.description:
Job Description

Division:
Compliance and Public Affairs

We are a dynamic team dedicated to managing Financial Crime risks across the Euroclear Group, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, and related compliance domains. As a key component of the Three Lines of Defence, Compliance & Ethics plays a critical role in safeguarding Euroclear’s integrity, protecting its reputation, and ensuring trust in the financial markets.

This opportunity sits within the Analytics & Tooling Team of the Compliance & Ethics Department, which is leading the digital transformation of Compliance & Ethics through the strategic use of AI, data, and digital solutions. We are seeking an individual who combines strong technical expertise with intellectual curiosity, problem-solving capabilities, and business acumen, while embracing and driving positive change.

Role

The role offers a unique opportunity to citizen development solutions for Compliance & Ethics using technologies such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate design and develop practical AI agents .
The successful candidate will also contribute to the development of data products leveraging the Cloud Data Platform, helping unlock insights and improve operational effectiveness across the function.

Alongside these technology-focused responsibilities, the role provides the opportunity to deepen your knowledge of financial crime compliance, governance, controls, and compliance practices, enabling you to build both technical and regulatory expertise in a high-impact and highly visible environment. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about innovation and eager to help shape the future of Compliance & Ethics.

Your Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

Support the divisional vision and strategy of providing smart, sensible data and digital solutions to empower Compliance & Ethics teams.
Act as the main interface between IT teams and specific business/functional areas from Compliance & ethics for end to end digital transformation providing solution building, roll outs and maintenance.
Administration and technical advisory for various compliance service domains and IT /Data/AI tools.
Elicit business functional and non-functional requirements and create clear perennial documentation (business process diagrams, high-level and detailed requirements, etc.).
Lead or contribute to citizen development initiatives using Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate, translating business needs into simple, robust, and maintainable solutions that improve efficiency, insight, and user experience.
Lead or contribute to the identification, design, development, testing, deployment, and adoption of practical AI agents and AI-enabled solutions, with a strong focus on Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot capabilities.
Build effective relationships and establish proactive interactions with Compliance teams, business managers, data suppliers, IT specialists, Power Platform experts, and other data analysts across the company.
Explore business problems with curiosity, challenge current ways of working, propose practical ideas, and contribute to initiatives that improve the functioning and productivity of the division through data, automation, AI, and citizen development.
Continuously learn, assess, and apply new technologies pragmatically, while also developing business understanding, compliance knowledge, and awareness of governance, risk management, and internal control practices.

Required Qualification

Technical Skills

You have a master's degree in a field whereAI/data is relevantor equivalent professional experience/specific certifications.
You have at least five years of experience in data, analytics, automation, AI, citizen development, digital solution delivery, or a related field.
You cananalyzebusiness flows and business problems, understand user needs, and translate them into practical, value-adding solutions.
You have hands-on experience with, or a strong ambition to develop expertise in, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI agents, prompt design, and practical AI use cases in a business environment.
You have hands-on experience with, or a strong ambition to develop expertise in, citizen development using Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate, including building solutions that are simple, maintainable, and adopted by users.
Experience with the following technologies is a plus:Copilot,Office 365, SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, relational databases and SQL,clouddataplatform(data lake), and Python.
Belonging to, and being active in, communities such as WeConnect, Power Platform, Power BI, Copilot, AI, or Data Scientist communities is a plus.

Soft skills

You are self-confident, autonomous, and able to work effectively as part of a team.
You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving concrete business problems.
You can collect, manage, evaluate, and use data and user requirements with sound critical thinking, strong data literacy, and a pragmatic delivery mindset.
You have strong presentation and communication skills and can promote the adoption of the AI, data, and citizen development solutions you build.
You are willing to continuously learn and develop not only technical skills, but also business understanding, compliance knowledge, and awareness of governance, risk management, and internal control.
You build relationships in a consultative style and care as much about how work is deliveredas well asabout what is delivered.
You take ownership of your assignments, handle them with empowerment, and seek consultation when necessary.
You can influence, constructively challenge, and negotiate at all levels.
You areorganisedand able to manage priorities autonomously.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

We offer

The opportunity to grow your career in a top-class compliance department with a strong reputation for excellence and quality, within a highly diverse team of motivated professionals.
A role at the intersection of Compliance, AI development, citizen development, data, automation, and innovation, with the chance to help shape practical Copilot Studio, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate use cases for the division.
Exposure to a wide range of data, digital, AI, and Power Platform technologies, as well as some of the most strategic and sensitive data in the company.
The possibility to deepen your knowledge of Euroclear businesses, Compliance, ethics, governance, risk management, and internal control, while further developing your AI, automation, and citizen development expertise.
Continuous professional development, with up to 10 days of training per year.
A comprehensive and transversal view of Euroclear and its businesses.
Support to acquire external qualifications and professional certifications.
A flexible work environment combining office presence and teleworking, with trust, accountability, and flexibility.

About Us

Why join us

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.

What We Offer

Work closely with inspiring, supportive and engaged colleagues from more than 80 different countries.
Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Join a learning and development environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

Ways of working

Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.

Great Place to Work for All

We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity and strives to be a Great Place to Work for All. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment, regardless of any aspect that makes them unique (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, disability, ...). If you need any specific accommodation due to disability or any other reason, you can let the recruiter know during your application process. Our values guide how we work together and shape our future: Our mission and values - Euroclear

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer with German (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma wartość tylko wtedy, gdy realnie wspiera ludzi i procesy. Tworzymy rozwiązania, które działają w praktyce – są skalowalne, stabilne i projektowane z myślą o długofalowym wykorzystaniu. Łączymy wiedzę techniczną z doświadczeniem projektowym zdobywanym w branżach przemysłowych i technologicznych. Pracujemy w międzynarodowym środowisku, stawiając na jakość, współpracę i ciągłe doskonalenie.

Projekt realizowany jest dla międzynarodowej firmy technologicznej z branży automotive, rozwijającej zaawansowaną platformę SaaS wspierającą sprzedaż i obsługę klientów. Rozwiązanie integruje procesy marketingowe, sprzedażowe i obsługę posprzedażową w jednym systemie, wspierając organizacje w zarządzaniu relacjami z klientami i optymalizacji procesów biznesowych.

Dlaczego warto rozważyć ten projekt?

To propozycja dla osób, które chcą pracować nad rozwojem skalowalnego produktu SaaS, wykorzystywanego w codziennej pracy przez organizacje na wielu rynkach. Projekt jest w fazie intensywnego rozwoju, co oznacza realny wpływ na architekturę, technologie oraz kierunek rozwoju platformy. Pracujesz w środowisku fullstackowym — zarówno przy backendzie (Java), jak i frontendzie (TypeScript), mając wpływ na cały cykl życia produktu. W projekcie wykorzystujesz język niemiecki w komunikacji z interesariuszami, jednocześnie pracując w szerszym, międzynarodowym środowisku.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji webowej w modelu fullstack (Java + TypeScript),
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz rozwój logiki biznesowej po stronie backendu i frontendu,
projektowanie i rozwój API oraz integrację systemu z zewnętrznymi rozwiązaniami,
pracę z technologiami backendowymi (Java, Spring Boot) oraz bazami danych (MySQL, Elasticsearch),
rozwój warstwy frontendowej z wykorzystaniem TypeScript oraz frameworków takich jak Vue.js,
analizę wymagań biznesowych i ich przekład na rozwiązania techniczne,
dbanie o jakość kodu poprzez testy jednostkowe i integracyjne oraz udział w code review,
diagnozowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów technicznych w środowisku produkcyjnym,
współpracę z zespołem produktowym i interesariuszami biznesowymi,
udział w procesach Agile oraz rozwój i usprawnianie praktyk zespołowych.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w tworzeniu aplikacji fullstack,
pracujesz z językiem Java oraz frameworkiem Spring Boot,
masz doświadczenie w pracy z TypeScript oraz frameworkami frontendowymi (np. Vue.js, React lub Angular),
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu API oraz integracji systemów,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych (np. MySQL) oraz rozwiązaniami typu Elasticsearch,
masz doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku SaaS lub przy rozwoju produktów,
znasz metodyki Agile/Scrum i pracowałeś/-aś w zespołach developerskich,
posługujesz się językiem niemieckim na poziomie minimum B2,
posługujesz się językiem angielskim na poziomie minimum B2,
dbasz o jakość kodu i stosujesz dobre praktyki programistyczne.

Docenimy również:

doświadczenie z AWS,
doświadczenie w pracy z CI/CD (np. GitLab CI/CD),
doświadczenie w pracy z architekturą mikroserwisową,
doświadczenie w pracy z produktami CRM lub systemami sprzedażowymi.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku produktowym,
udział w rozwoju platformy wykorzystywanej na wielu rynkach,
możliwość pracy zdalnej,
realny wpływ na rozwój produktu i technologii,
współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem technologicznym.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Wyślij nam swoje CV – najlepiej w języku angielskim. W formularzu daj nam znać, jakie masz oczekiwania finansowe, preferowaną formę współpracy oraz od kiedy możesz rozpocząć pracę.
Sprawdzimy Twoją aplikację – przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i zobaczymy, jak pasuje do tej roli i projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) – luźna, partnerska rozmowa (ok. 40–60 minut), żeby lepiej się poznać, porozmawiać o Twojej drodze zawodowej, motywacji i oczekiwaniach.
Krótkie spotkanie językowe (online) – około 10–15 minutowa rozmowa z native speakerem, podczas której zweryfikujemy Twoją znajomość języka niemieckiego.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) – spotkanie z osobami z zespołu projektowego.
Feedback – po zakończeniu procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

jobs.title: Senior .NET utvecklare inom AML
jobs.description:
Om rollen

Som Senior .NET-utvecklare blir du en nyckelperson i Skandias AML-team (Anti-Money Laundering), där ni utvecklar systemstöd för att förebygga penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism – ett affärskritiskt uppdrag med tydlig samhällsnytta.

Du arbetar nära både verksamhet och teknik och är delaktig i att designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla stabila och säkra lösningar. Rollen innebär att bidra i design-, arkitektur- och kravdiskussioner samt vara med och fatta tekniska vägval tillsammans med teamet.

Arbetet fokuserar på backendutveckling i .NET/C# och eventdriven arkitektur i en säkerhetskänslig miljö med stora datamängder och höga krav på tillförlitlighet.

Du utvecklar och optimerar integrationer mot andra system, samarbetar nära teamet genom exempelvis par- och mobbprogrammering och bidrar till kontinuerlig förbättring av kod, arbetssätt och lösningar.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som trivs i en utvecklarroll där kvalitet, säkerhet och stabila lösningar är avgörande. Du är van att arbeta i affärskritiska systemmiljöer och har erfarenhet av att ta ansvar för tekniska lösningar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen – från design och implementation till vidareutveckling och förbättring.

Du arbetar strukturerat, har ett analytiskt förhållningssätt och trivs med att samarbeta nära andra utvecklare. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till att utveckla både teamets arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar.

Du har även ett intresse för att ligga i framkant inom AI-stödd systemutveckling, till exempel genom verktyg som GitHub Copilot.

Du har erfarenhet av

Systemutveckling i C# / .NET
Backendutveckling och integrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar
ASP.NET / MVC och REST-baserade API:er
Databashantering med MS SQL, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core eller Dapper
Versionshantering och CI/CD-flöden
Kommunikation på svenska, i tal och skrift

Vad händer nu?

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning. Du kan läsa mer om vår process här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Stephan Mannerfelt på stephan.mannerfelt@skandia.se

Om du har frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Partner, Madelene Skogh, på madelene.skogh@skandia.se

Vi återkopplar till alla som söker, oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

The opportunity

We are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious AI & Digital Systems Architect to define and govern the architecture required to integrate artificial intelligence into industrial products, engineering workflows, and business processes.

The role connects control systems, edge and cloud platforms, engineering tools, enterprise applications, and governed data foundations to create scalable, secure, reusable, and production-ready AI capabilities. The architect translates business and engineering needs into end-to-end solution blueprints, guides solutions from experimentation to operational deployment, and ensures that model quality, explainability, cybersecurity, human oversight, lifecycle governance, and measurable value are engineered into every AI-enabled capability.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Define and govern end-to-end architectures for AI-enabled products, digital solutions, and engineering workflows across OT, edge, cloud, data, and enterprise environments.
Establish AI architecture standards, reference architectures, reusable design patterns, and best practices for scalable and maintainable solutions.
Partner with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-value AI use cases that create measurable business impact.
Drive the integration of AI across engineering, operations, service, and digital processes, from concept and proof of concept through industrialization and adoption.
Architect AI-enabled capabilities for industrial control systems, automation solutions, HMI/SCADA applications, edge devices, and digital products.
Define data, knowledge, and platform architectures leveraging technologies such as data platforms, lakehouses, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and digital twins.
Establish MLOps and LLMOps practices covering deployment, monitoring, testing, evaluation, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of AI solutions.
Ensure AI solutions meet requirements for security, privacy, reliability, explainability, compliance, and responsible AI governance.
Design scalable integration patterns, APIs, and data flows connecting OT systems, engineering tools, enterprise applications, and cloud services.
Act as the technical authority for AI and digital systems architecture, mentoring teams and aligning strategy across software, data, cloud, cybersecurity, and business functions.

Your background

PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in software, systems, data, AI/ML, industrial automation, or other mission-critical digital platforms.
Strong expertise in enterprise and systems architecture, software lifecycle management, data architectures, AI/ML engineering, and industrial automation.
Proven track record of defining end-to-end architectures and delivering AI-enabled solutions from concept and prototyping to scalable production environments.
Hands-on experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agentic AI, and the integration of AI capabilities into applications, platforms, and industrial products.
Deep understanding of AI engineering practices including MLOps/LLMOps, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, observability, governance, explainability, and responsible AI.
Strong background in modern data architectures including data products, pipelines, lakehouse and streaming solutions, time-series data, vector databases, data governance, and lineage.
Experience with cloud-native and distributed architectures, including microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, containers, orchestration, and hybrid or edge deployments.
Knowledge of industrial and enterprise environments, including OT/IT integration, SCADA, HMI, PLC/DCS, digital twins, as well as PLM, ERP, simulation, analytics, and workflow platforms.
Proficiency in Python, modern AI/ML frameworks, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP; familiarity with TOGAF, ArchiMate, C4, cybersecurity, data protection, regulatory compliance, and engineering tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or PSCAD is considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Pensions and Spend
jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer - Investments

About Kota

Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products - Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution - we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.

Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

The role & team

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.

The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.

On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

What You'll Do

Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
Contribute to frontend code (React + TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
Use AI actively in your day-to-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

What We're Looking For

6+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs
Strong understanding of data modelling, event-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast-growing startup
AI-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

Why join us?

Technically interesting problem - pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised
Modern stack - .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event-driven
Agency - we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
Customer proximity - you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it
High-quality culture - we care about clean design and thoughtful engineering
Impact from day one - we're a small, focused team. What you build ships fast and matters
AI-first - we invest heavily in AI tooling and token usage. We're not precious about the spend, if it helps you build better or faster, use it

Our hiring process

Introductory call (30 mins): a casual chat with one or two of our product team
Technical interview (90 mins): a collaborative, open-book session with two engineers, working through a real-world problem together
Call with founders (30 mins): we'll share our vision and hear your thoughts
Final response: we'll follow up promptly with next steps

Kota Benefits

Health insurance via Kota
Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
WFH stipend to support your home office setup
Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
Access to office space in Dublin or a co-working space, wherever you're based
Flexible working hours, we're remote-first with some fixed hours for team alignment

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

The International team is seeking a talented and driven Software Engineer II to join CarGurus' first engineering team in Ireland and work on exciting product initiatives for our Canadian and UK markets. In this role, you’ll be responsible for the full software development lifecycle – across both the frontend and backend – collaborating with Engineering and Product peers to design innovative solutions and tackle complex challenges for our dealer-facing products.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Are Able To Learn And Adapt Quickly, And Collaborate With Other Engineers To Deliver Solutions. Some Examples Of Potential Project Opportunities

Building new, full-stack features for dealer products from the ground up
Integrating with existing services and expanding functionality using React, TypeScript, and Java
Implementing integrations with third-party APIs and partners

As an engineer on this team, you will work closely with other engineers and product partners to deliver impactful solutions for the international business. No need to be a car expert—we’re more interested in your passion for engineering and your ability to innovate!

What You'll Do

Help establish and grow CarGurus' Dublin engineering presence by contributing to team culture, practices, and standards.
Collaborate with engineers and product managers across the organization to understand and solve new product requirements and tackle technical challenges.
Work with Java, Spring Boot, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, AWS, and other modern technologies to build consumer and dealer products.
Collaborate on system design and write well-crafted code to help evolve our service-oriented architecture.
Be deeply engaged in the full development lifecycle: designing, developing, testing, automated testing, deploying, maintaining, monitoring, and alerting.

What You'll Bring

2-5 years of hands-on software development experience in a professional setting.
Experience building full-stack applications with frameworks similar to Spring Boot, NextJS, Express, ASP.NET, Django, or Rails.
Ability to write clean, well-tested, and efficient code that passes through code review with minimal comments. Additionally, you will engage with code reviews by giving and receiving feedback to ensure high-quality outcomes.
The ability to iterate and ship ideas quickly and independently.

Embed security and compliance best practices across infrastructure, including access control, encryption, and policy enforcement.
Drive continuous service improvement initiatives to enhance performance, reliability, efficiency, and operational maturity.
Collaborate closely with Development and QA teams to improve application resilience and supportability.

Key Requirements

Proven experience as a Site Reliability Engineer or in a similar reliability-focused role within a SaaS or cloud-native environment.
Strong hands-on experience operating production workloads on Microsoft Azure across compute, networking, storage, and monitoring services.

jobs.title: AI Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI Developer to our team in Espoo or Tampere!

This permanent position is about building AI solutions that do real work in our customers' processes, and making them reliable enough to run in production. The role can be tailored according to your preferences and skills: some of our developers spend more time with the customer shaping which processes are worth automating, others go deeper into the orchestration, evaluation and operations side.

You will join a team of experienced professionals from different areas of software expertise. We work in a hybrid mode, but in this role we expect strong presence in Espoo or Tampere.

Naturally, you will have access to modern tools and strong co-operation with your colleagues.

One of our strengths in career development is our diverse range of clients and various projects in different fields. That enables us to offer versatile opportunities for our employees. At Etteplan, we are concentrating on helping our customers especially in industrial system digitalization, which means the agents you build will touch engineering data, technical documentation, service processes and industrial operations, not just chat interfaces. Many of these customers have strict requirements about where their data may go, so running models locally and on-premises is a direction we are actively building capability in.

As an AI Developer at Etteplan, the role would include (but not be limited to):

Map customer processes into agentic workflows: decide what the agent decides, what a tool does, and where a human stays in the loop
Design and build tool-using agents that plan and execute multi-step tasks, including task decomposition, state and memory handling, and controlled autonomy
Build and maintain the tool and integration layer: tool contracts and schemas, structured input and output, validation and retries, and connections to customer APIs, databases, document repositories and operational systems
Build the application around the agent, from the user-facing interface to backend services, databases, authentication and deployment pipelines
Deploy solutions where the customer needs them, whether that is Azure, another cloud, the customer's own servers, or an on-premises environment running local models
Implement the controls that make AI acceptable in an industrial context: permissions, policy checks, audit logs, and correct handling of confidential customer data
Stay up to date with the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and help us decide what is production-ready and what is not

We are looking for a person who has:

Proven experience building LLM-based applications that reached production, not only prototypes and demos
Hands-on experience with agent frameworks and orchestration, for example LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Semantic Kernel, Copilot Studio, n8n or equivalent
Experience working against AI and LLM APIs from several providers, including tool and function calling, structured output, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) or comparable ways of exposing tools and data to an agent
Full-stack capability: you can take a solution from user interface through backend services, databases, APIs and authentication to a running deployment
Docker and containers as part of your normal way of working, together with CI/CD and monitoring
Familiarity with cloud platforms, Azure in particular, and with AWS or Google Cloud as a plus
Ability to work directly with customers, translate ambiguous requirements into something buildable, and explain trade-offs in plain language
Working proficiency in English; Finnish is a strong advantage in customer work

We appreciate also, if you are familiar with:

Local and self-hosted inference
Efficient handling of large volumes of data
Evaluation of non-deterministic systems
Industrial context: manufacturing, energy, machinery, medical devices or defence and security, and the systems around them such as MES, PLM, ERP, IIoT or technical documentation and CCMS environments

The salary range is quite wide, reflecting our openness to both earlier‑career and more experienced professionals. What matters most to us is finding the right competencies and fit and aligning the role and compensation to match.
