jobs.description:
Vi skalerer platformen bag Danmarks største online apotek til næste niveau — cloud-native infrastruktur, GitOps og AI. Vil du være med til at forme rejsen?

Om os

Apoteka udvikler og driver platformen bag Apopro - Danmarks største online apotek. Platformen forbinder apotekersystem, lager, logistik og webshop end-to-end.

Vores mål er at gøre medicin og sundhedsrådgivning lettere tilgængelig for alle. Vi måler succes både på vækst og på den forskel, vi gør for mennesker og samfund.

Om rollen

Du bliver en del af vores Pharm Engineering-team, der fokuserer på de centrale processer i apotekersystemet og ordrebehandling: ordrer, recepter, lager, tilskud og integrationer til sundhedssektoren.

Som DevOps engineer er du grundlæggende software engineer, men med et særligt speciale i automatiseringer, infrastruktur, og i moderniseringen af vores arkitektur. Du får en central rolle i at drive, sikre og videreudvikle den platform og cloud-infrastruktur, som resten af udviklingen bygger på.

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle punkter nedenfor for at søge — vi ser både på meget erfarne ansøgere, og på dem med et par års erfaring, som er sultne efter at udvikle sig videre ind i rollen. Har du mindre erfaring på nogle af de konkrete områder, men er hurtig til at lære nyt, nysgerrig og tror på, at du vil passe godt ind i teamet, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig alligevel.

Dine opgaver:

De daglige opgaver kredser sig primært omkring:
Drive og videreudvikle vores Kubernetes-platform: deploye, opgradere og operere clusters.
Automatisk skalering (autoscaling) af VMs og containere baseret på load.
Infrastructure as Code med Kubernetes samt GitOps, GitHub Actions og CI/CD.
Automatisere manuelt arbejde frem for at akkumulere manuelle driftsopgaver — herunder med AI-værktøjer, hvor det giver mening.
Være med til at forbedre vores udviklingsproces med AI-værktøjer og sætte de rette guard rails omkring dem.
Observability og monitorering for at forbedre både performance og stabilitet.
Have blik for omkostninger og effektivitet (FinOps) — ikke kun oppetid.
Sikkerhed: håndtering af secrets, netværkssegmentering og kryptering, både at-rest og in-transit.
Bidrage til teamets kvalitet igennem team-ritualer, reviews, tests og refactoring.

Vi er i gang med en større modernisering af vores cloud platform, og her spiller du en nøglerolle:
Migrere databaser — mellem forskellige hosts og i visse tilfælde fra én teknologi til en anden.
Migrere fra .NET Framework 4.x til moderne .NET 10: SDK-style projekter og modernisering af afhængigheder.
Dekomponere monolitter og store databaser til mindre services og databaser.
Andre opgaver på platformens udvikling.

Hvad vi leder efter:

En engageret og nysgerrig platformsudvikler, med en god portion gå-på-mod og stærke evner.
En team-player, der er service-minded og deler gavmildt ud af sin viden — både over for kolleger i og uden for eget team.
God erfaring med Kubernetes operations: deploy, opgradering og drift af clusters.
Godt kendskab til Linux, netværk og security groups/firewalls (private netværk, egress control, NAT/edge). Kendskab til Windows Server er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
Erfaring med moderne cloud-native platforme og infrastructure-as-code værdsættes højt.
Gode evner i .NET, C#, databaser og API'er er et plus, men ikke et hårdt krav — du er stadig udvikler i bund og grund. Andre teknologier i vores stak er bl.a. SQL Server, Redis, RabbitMq, Elastic og uCommerce/Umbraco.
En automatiseringsfokuseret tilgang: du løser tilbagevendende opgaver med automatisering frem for manuelt arbejde
Interesse for at være med til at forme, hvordan vi som team bruger AI-værktøjer i udviklingsprocessen, herunder de guard rails der skal til for at gøre det sikkert og ansvarligt.
En pragmatisk og inkrementel tilgang: du kan modernisere løbende, sideløbende med roadmap og feature-udvikling — ikke ved at fryse alt andet.
Kritisk tænkende og interesseret i fortsat forbedring af både hvad vi laver og hvordan vi laver det. Du kan både løse komplekse opgaver selvstændigt og hjælpe resten af teamet med at forbedre vores system.

Vi tilbyder:

En vigtig rolle i et firma hvor din stemme kan høres.
En spændende arbejdsplads med høj medarbejdertilfredshed, hvor de mange fagligheder i pharma, e-commerce, warehouse, og tech, arbejder sammen for en fælles sag.
Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både personligt og fagligt.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi finder den rette kandidat.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med reference til Engineering Manager, Jacob Bonde Larsen. Din arbejdsplads vil hovedsageligt være i Greve, men med fleksibilitet til at arbejde nogle dage på vores lokation i København eller hjemme.

jobs.description:
If you wish to further develop your career with one of the world’s leading logistics companies, this is an excellent opportunity to join our global team and shape the future of business automation at Kuehne+Nagel.

It's more than a job

As Senior Software Engineer – Power Platform & Automation Consulting, you combine strong software engineering capabilities with trusted business consulting. You identify strategic automation opportunities, advise senior stakeholders and translate complex business challenges into secure, scalable and user-centric solutions based on Microsoft Power Platform and the wider Microsoft technology stack.

You take end-to-end ownership—from discovery, process analysis and solution design through development, testing, deployment and continuous improvement.

In addition, you act as an enabler for business and functional units by helping non-technical stakeholders understand automation opportunities, make informed decisions and realize measurable business value.

Success is measured by the quality, reliability, adoption and business impact of the solutions delivered, as well as your ability to build trusted relationships across business and IT.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Act as a trusted technology and automation consultant for business leaders and senior management.
Identify, assess and prioritise automation opportunities together with business and functional units.
Facilitate discovery workshops and translate business needs into clear requirements, solution concepts, roadmaps and value cases.
Explain technical capabilities, constraints, risks and architectural decisions in clear business language to non-IT audiences.
Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain enterprise-ready solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps, Power Automate and Copilot Studio.
Extend Power Platform solutions with Microsoft Azure services, APIs, custom connectors and professional-code components where appropriate.
Build robust integrations with Microsoft 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, enterprise applications and approved data sources.
Apply sound software engineering practices, including modular design, source control, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring and technical documentation.
Ensure solutions comply with enterprise architecture, information security, data protection, governance and application lifecycle management requirements.
Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, decision papers, demonstrations and management updates for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Take ownership of the complete solution lifecycle, including production support, performance monitoring, incident analysis and continuous optimisation.
Collaborate effectively with product teams, architects, business analysts, security teams, platform administrators and citizen developers across a global organisation.
Coach business teams and citizen developers on solution design, platform capabilities, development standards and responsible automation practices.
Contribute reusable components, patterns, standards and best practices to strengthen the organisation’s Power Platform and automation capabilities.
Evaluate new Microsoft technologies and recommend their use based on business value, technical fit, security and maintainability.

Your Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Informatics or a comparable discipline; equivalent professional experience is also welcome.
Several years of professional experience in software engineering, solution development or enterprise automation.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Copilot Studio.
Experience extending low-code solutions through Azure services, REST APIs, custom connectors, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, .NET, Power Fx or comparable technologies.
Sound knowledge of software architecture, integration patterns, data modelling, security concepts and application lifecycle management.
Practical experience with source control, automated testing and CI/CD, for example using Git and Azure DevOps or GitHub.
Proven consulting experience in analysing complex business challenges and advising senior management or executive-level stakeholders.
Ability to connect business strategy, process improvement and technology, and to translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Excellent presentation, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with confidence in leading workshops and management discussions.
Excellent analytical, structured problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly and convincingly to non-technical audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.
Experience working in global, cross-functional and agile teams.
Strong ownership mentality, customer orientation and ability to manage several priorities independently.
Knowledge of Power Platform governance, security, environment strategy, licensing and Centre of Excellence practices is a strong advantage.
Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications are an advantage.
Experience in logistics, supply chain management or another process-intensive enterprise environment is an advantage.
Experience with process mining, RPA, AI-enabled automation, OCR or document-processing technologies is an advantage.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

jobs.title: Test Engineer for SmartLink IoT Platform
jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a Test Engineer who owns the quality of that backbone.

You are the quality owner of the platform itself, not of the screens in front of it. Your working level is services, APIs, messages and data: does a domain service behave as its contract promises, does a telemetry value survive ingestion, aggregation and retrieval unchanged, and does any of it still hold at the scale of a global fleet. You work in an agile team of developers, architects and product owners, following and sharpening our platform testing standard
so that quality is a property of how we build, not a phase at the end. The total platform team is 14 people.

Test automation here is real engineering. Our suites are written in C# on .NET
by the same standards as the product code: xUnit, Testcontainers
to spin up Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse per run, .NET Aspire
to bring up the distributed application, and a shared helper library published as a NuGet package so every service team tests against the same building blocks. Suites run in Azure DevOps
pipelines per component and per environment, reporting into Xray
.

Your first months land in the middle of a platform generation change, with two generations running side by side while we migrate. It is a demanding start and the fastest way to learn the platform inside out, but it is not the whole job: the migration will finish, the platform will keep growing, and so will your scope.

In This Role, You Will

Test the platform where it lives: contract, schema and integration testing of domain services and APIs, message and event flows, and the persistence behind them.
Validate the data, not just the code: event streams, time-series and aggregated telemetry, from the message a device sends to the value the platform serves to its consumers.
Extend the shared test framework the other service teams build on, and keep those suites running as quality gates in CI/CD rather than by hand.
Solve testability as a design problem. Where a service cannot be validated on its own, work out what is needed (governed test data, stubs, simulators, contract tests, observability) and get it into the backlog before the feature is built, instead of testing on production machines.
Hold the platform to what it promises its consumers. The portal, the mobile apps and internal consumers depend on your services, so you own those contracts and work with those teams on the flows that cross the boundary.
Cover performance and load at fleet scale, through harnesses that drive the real processing pipeline rather than a simplified copy of it.
Prove migrations and domain transitions: dual-source comparison between old and new, backward compatibility per domain, and confidence at cutover.
Shape quality upstream and after the fact: turn requirements into test cases during refinement, challenge anything that cannot be verified, and triage defects across service boundaries.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

Solid grounding in testing methodology, QA practice and defect analysis: functional, regression and risk-based testing.
You test services and APIs directly, not through a user interface. REST and messaging, schemas and contracts are your natural working level.
You write test code, and you write it properly: readable, reviewed, running in a CI/CD pipeline. We work in C# on .NET with xUnit; another statically typed language is fine, and we give you the room to switch.
Hands-on with SQL and comfortable judging whether data and aggregations are actually correct.
A working understanding of distributed, service-based architectures: asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency, and the ways they fail in practice.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something is not testable as specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at Airpower in Wilrijk, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

oin Amaris Consulting

As a Senior Full‑Stack Engineer

✅ What we’re looking for

7+ years of experience as a Full‑Stack or Backend Engineer working with Python and/or .NET in complex enterprise environments.
Strong experience designing and building Python‑based services, ideally including AI agents or integrations with cloud AI platforms.
Solid experience with .NET Core for building RESTful APIs and backend services.
Experience with modern frontend frameworks, ideally Angular, and with web components (Stencil or similar) and micro frontend architectures.
Strong knowledge of relational databases (preferably SQL Server): writing complex queries, understanding schemas, and integrating with existing data models.
Experience with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and cloud deployments (Azure/AWS/GCP).
Solid understanding of software architecture and distributed systems (modularization, scalability, resilience).
Experience integrating with or modernizing legacy enterprise systems without impacting existing functionality.
Good understanding of security best practices: identity and access management, trust boundaries, idempotency, audit trails, PII protection, feature flags/kill switches.
Hands‑on experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) and use of Git.
Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices: clean code, design patterns, testing, code review, documentation.
Professional level of English, able to collaborate with international teams – your day‑to‑day work will be in English.

Design, build, and maintain Python‑based AI agents using modern agentic frameworks and cloud AI runtimes.
Develop and maintain .NET Core APIs that act as downstream services for the AI agent layer.

Principal Backend Engineer | C# / .NET / Distributed Systems (M/F/D)

We are looking for a Principal Backend Engineer to join our team!

Someone who has designed, built, operated and evolved distributed backend systems in production, understands how they fail, and knows how to make pragmatic technical decisions when there is no perfect solution.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture discussions and actual implementation.

#.NET #C# #DistributedSystems

Quick details

📍Portugal based
💻 Remote work model and flexible schedule
⚙️ Backend / C# / .NET / Azure
🏗️ Microservices & distributed systems
📨 Event-driven architecture

Your Mission

This is a hands-on technical role. You will design and build backend systems, make architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, and help other engineers solve complex technical problems.

About Us

At Lyzer, we empower retailers and e-commerce businesses with innovative technology solutions, driving operational excellence and growth in a dynamic market.
Our mission is to revolutionize the logistics landscape, enabling unprecedented efficiency and exceptional customer experiences.
Our platform is based on microservices and asynchronous communication with an event-driven architecture, supporting a Logistics as a Service ecosystem.

Responsibilities (Your Day-to-Day)

Own and influence the architecture of critical backend systems across multiple domains
Design scalable and resilient solutions using C#, .NET and microservices

Design and evolve event-driven and asynchronous workflows

Define service boundaries, integration approaches and communication patterns
Make architectural decisions considering scalability, reliability, maintainability and operational complexity
Establish and promote engineering standards, patterns and best practices across teams
Help engineers make better technical decisions through mentoring, design reviews and code reviews
Drive improvements in performance, observability, testing, CI/CD and production reliability
Proactively identify technical risks and opportunities before they become problems

Requirements

8+ years of professional software development experience
, with significant experience building backend systems using C# and .NET
.
Strong hands-on experience designing and operating microservices and distributed systems in production
.
Proven experience with event-driven architectures
and messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS or equivalent
.
Strong understanding of asynchronous systems and failure scenarios, including concepts such as: idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, eventual consistency, transactional messaging
Strong experience with relational databases and SQL Server
; Azure SQL experience is highly valued.
Strong understanding of software architecture and design principles such as DDD, SOLID and Clean Architecture
.
Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure
, including serverless services such as Azure Functions.
Experience with automated testing, CI/CD and production observability.
Experience mentoring other engineers and influencing technical decisions across teams.
Good communication skills in English.
Previous experience using AI development assistants as part of the engineering workflow

Perks / Benefits

🍽️ Meal allowance card (x12 months)
🕰️ Remote work model and flexible schedule
💻 Computer to facilitate your work
💳 Competitive salary with fixed and variable income, allowing the individual to grow with the company
📚 Access to technical training platforms in different areas to support your professional development
🚀 Startup environment offering you a dynamic and collaborative culture where innovation and entrepreneurship are encouraged
🏥 Other fringe benefits such as health insurance, gym or school-vouchers.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Legacy Specialist & AI Expert)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

The Project: Internal Support Tools Evolution

You are joining an initiative focused on the evolution, modernization of the Internal Application Landscape. This project involves the strategic transition of well-known cloud services and legacy .NET architectures into a next-generation, AI-augmented, and cloud-native software landscape.

Our goal is not simply to "maintain" the existing system, but to proactively transform it—ensuring sovereignty, high-performance scalability, and seamless handover readiness through disciplined engineering.

Our Engineering Philosophy

We operate at the intersection of Legacy Stability and Modern Innovation. Our approach is defined by:

AI-Augmented Engineering: We utilize advanced AI development environments (such as Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code) and cutting-edge model families to accelerate code comprehension, refactoring, and documentation.
Disciplined SDLC Patterns: We move beyond traditional development by implementing repeatable, evidence-based SDLC patterns. Every change is backed by structured engineering evidence and rigorous automated testing.
The "Strangler Fig" Modernization: We prioritize risk-mitigated evolution, using sophisticated patterns to wrap, refactor, and eventually replace legacy components.
High-Seniority Autonomy: We operate as a lean, highly autonomous unit. We value "technical detectives" who can navigate ambiguity and perform deep reverse engineering.

Mission

To drive the technical execution of both high-impact feature development and the deep-dive modernization of our legacy .NET ecosystem. You will be a specialist who finds satisfaction in solving complex puzzles, utilizing AI-assisted tools to accelerate the modernization of our core systems.

Role Focus

This role focuses on high-complexity coding, deep reverse engineering, and AI-augmented productivity. You will work in the trenches of the legacy codebase, extracting logic and implementing modern, testable solutions using the latest AI-powered development environments.

Key Responsibilities

Complex Feature & Refactoring: Design and implement sophisticated new functionalities within the existing .NET ecosystem, ensuring seamless integration with legacy components.
Deep Reverse Engineering: Analyze and deconstruct complex, undocumented, or "spaghetti" legacy code to understand underlying business rules and technical flows.
AI-Augmented Coding: Proactively utilize AI coding assistants and advanced environments (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, or VS Code extensions) to accelerate code comprehension, documentation, and refactoring.
Robust Testing & Stability: Write high-quality unit and integration tests to "wrap" legacy modules, providing a safety net for all refactoring efforts.
Technical Troubleshooting: Act as a high-level escalation point for complex bugs and performance bottlenecks within the legacy environment.
Internal Tooling: Utilize Microsoft PowerApps to build rapid, lightweight administrative or maintenance utilities to support the development and operations lifecycle.

Qualifications

Experience: 6+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in the .NET/C# stack.
Legacy Navigation: Proven experience working with older .NET versions (e.g., .NET Framework) and managing the complexities of monolithic architectures.
AI Tooling Proficiency: Hands-on familiarity with AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, or local model experimentation.
Core Skills: Mastery of SOLID principles, design patterns, and advanced debugging/profiling techniques.
Testing Mindset: Strong commitment to TDD and automated testing (Unit/Integration) to protect the legacy core.

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Entwickler (m/w/d) Legacy Specialist & AI Expert
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgabe

Du wirst Teil einer Initiative, die sich auf die Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung der internen Anwendungslandschaft
konzentriert. Dieses Projekt umfasst den strategischen Übergang bekannter Cloud-Services und Legacy-.NET-Architekturen in eine Next-Generation-, KI-erweiterte und Cloud-native Softwarelandschaft. Das Ziel besteht nicht einfach darin, das bestehende System zu warten, sondern es proaktiv zu transformieren – um Souveränität, hochperformante Skalierbarkeit und nahtlose Übergabebereitschaft durch diszipliniertes Engineering sicherzustellen.

Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf hochkomplexes Coding, tiefgreifendes Reverse Engineering und KI-erweiterte Produktivität
. Du arbeitest in den Tiefen der Legacy-Codebasis, extrahierst Logik und implementierst moderne, testbare Lösungen unter Verwendung der neuesten KI-gestützten Entwicklungsumgebungen. Deine Mission besteht darin, die technische Umsetzung sowohl von wirkungsvoller Feature-Entwicklung als auch der tiefgreifenden Modernisierung des Legacy-.NET-Ökosystems voranzutreiben. Du bist ein Spezialist, der Zufriedenheit darin findet, komplexe Rätsel zu lösen und KI-gestützte Tools zu nutzen, um die Modernisierung von Kernsystemen zu beschleunigen.

Der Engineering-Ansatz operiert an der Schnittstelle von Legacy-Stabilität und moderner Innovation, nutzt KI-erweitertes Engineering mit fortschrittlichen KI-Entwicklungsumgebungen (wie Cursor, Windsurf und Claude Code), implementiert disziplinierte SDLC-Muster mit wiederholbaren, evidenzbasierten Ansätzen, priorisiert risikominimierte Evolution unter Verwendung des „Strangler Fig"-Modernisierungsmusters und agiert als schlanke, hochautonome Einheit, die technische Detektive schätzt, die Mehrdeutigkeit navigieren und tiefgreifendes Reverse Engineering durchführen können.

Hauptaufgaben

Komplexe Features & Refactoring: Entwurf und Implementierung anspruchsvoller neuer Funktionalitäten innerhalb des bestehenden .NET-Ökosystems unter Sicherstellung nahtloser Integration mit Legacy-Komponenten
Tiefgreifendes Reverse Engineering: Analyse und Dekonstruktion komplexen, undokumentierten oder „Spaghetti"-Legacy-Codes, um zugrunde liegende Geschäftsregeln und technische Abläufe zu verstehen
KI-erweitertes Coding: Proaktive Nutzung von KI-Coding-Assistenten und fortschrittlichen Umgebungen (z.B. Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code oder VS Code Extensions), um Code-Verständnis, Dokumentation und Refactoring zu beschleunigen
Robustes Testing & Stabilität: Schreiben hochwertiger Unit- und Integrationstests, um Legacy-Module zu „umhüllen" und ein Sicherheitsnetz für alle Refactoring-Bemühungen bereitzustellen
Technisches Troubleshooting: Agieren als hochrangiger Eskalationspunkt für komplexe Bugs und Performance-Engpässe innerhalb der Legacy-Umgebung
Interne Tools: Nutzung von Microsoft PowerApps zum Aufbau schneller, leichtgewichtiger administrativer oder Wartungs-Utilities zur Unterstützung des Entwicklungs- und Betriebslebenszyklus

Dein Profil

Wir suchen einen hocherfahrenen .NET/C# Senior Developer
mit fundierter Expertise in der Modernisierung von Legacy-Systemen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungstools und fortgeschrittenen Software-Engineering-Praktiken. Der ideale Kandidat ist ein technischer Detektiv, der sich durch Reverse Engineering komplexer Codebasen auszeichnet und robuste, testbare Lösungen implementiert.

Muss-Kriterien

Mindestens 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung
Fundierte Expertise im .NET/C#-Stack
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit älteren .NET-Versionen (z.B. .NET Framework)
Erfahrung im Umgang mit den Komplexitäten monolithischer Architekturen
Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Coding-Assistenten
Erfahrung mit Prompt Engineering oder Experimenten mit lokalen Modellen
Beherrschung der SOLID-Prinzipien
Beherrschung von Design Patterns
Fortgeschrittene Debugging-Techniken
Fortgeschrittene Profil
ing-Techniken
Starkes Engagement für TDD (Test-Driven Development)
Starkes Engagement für automatisierte Tests (Unit/Integration)

Über uns

Als attraktivster Arbeitgeber Ungarns 2025 (laut repräsentativer Umfrage von Randstad) ist Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
eine Tochtergesellschaft der Deutsche Telekom Gruppe. Das Unternehmen bietet mit mehr als 5300 Mitarbeitern ein breites Portfolio an IT- und Telekommunikationsdienstleistungen. Wir haben Hunderte von Großkunden und Konzernen in Deutschland und anderen europäischen Ländern.

DT-ITS erhielt 2019 den Best in Educational Cooperation Award von HIPA
und wurde als ethischstes multinationales Unternehmen 2019

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer / SDET (AI & Parity Focus)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

The Project: Internal Support Tools Evolution

You are joining an initiative focused on the evolution, modernization of the Internal Application Landscape. This project involves the strategic transition of well-known cloud services and legacy .NET architectures into a next-generation, AI-augmented, and cloud-native software landscape.

Our goal is not simply to "maintain" the existing system, but to proactively transform it—ensuring sovereignty, high-performance scalability, and seamless handover readiness through disciplined engineering.

Our Engineering Philosophy

We operate at the intersection of Legacy Stability and Modern Innovation. Our approach is defined by:

AI-Augmented Engineering: We utilize advanced AI development environments (such as Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code) and cutting-edge model families to accelerate code comprehension, refactoring, and documentation.
Disciplined SDLC Patterns: We move beyond traditional development by implementing repeatable, evidence-based SDLC patterns. Every change is backed by structured engineering evidence and rigorous automated testing.
The "Strangler Fig" Modernization: We prioritize risk-mitigated evolution, using sophisticated patterns to wrap, refactor, and eventually replace legacy components.
High-Seniority Autonomy: We operate as a lean, highly autonomous unit. We value "technical detectives" who can navigate ambiguity and perform deep reverse engineering.

Mission

To build the automated safety net that makes our modernization efforts possible. You will ensure that as we evolve the Internal Application Landscape, we maintain absolute functional parity and prevent any regressions in our mission-critical business logic.

Role Focus

This role focuses on building scalable automation frameworks and implementing AI-driven testing strategies. You will verify that modernized components produce identical business outcomes to the legacy systems they replace, using both traditional and AI-augmented testing techniques.

Key Responsibilities

Automated Regression & Parity Testing: Design and maintain comprehensive automated regression suites to protect legacy functionality and verify functional parity during migration.
AI-Augmented Testing: Leverage AI-powered tools for automated test generation, self-healing test scripts, and intelligent visual regression testing.
Framework Development: Build and optimize scalable automation frameworks (UI, API, and Integration levels) specifically tailored for .NET and modern cloud-native environments.
Continuous Testing (CI/CD): Integrate automated test suites into DevOps pipelines (GitLab/GitHub/Jenkins) to provide immediate, high-confidence feedback.
API & Integration Testing: Validate complex data flows and integrations between legacy monoliths and new, modern services.
Collaboration: Work side-by-side with Developers and Architects to identify "testable" areas in legacy code and advocate for improved testability.

Qualifications

Experience: 5+ years in automated software testing, with a strong background in software engineering/SDET.
Automation Mastery: Proficiency with Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress, and API testing frameworks (RestSharp, etc.).
AI/Modern Testing: Hands-on familiarity with AI coding/testing assistants and the ability to implement automated regression strategies in complex environments.
Programming Proficiency: Strong coding skills in C# to build and maintain sophisticated test automation code.
Analytical Rigor: A detective mindset with the ability to translate undocumented legacy behaviors into precise, automated test scenarios.

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

jobs.description:
Penta Consulting are a technology resource solutions provider to leading OEMs across the EMEA region.

Role Overview

The Senior Laserfiche ECM Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting automation-centric ECM solutions using Laserfiche and Microsoft development technologies. The role focuses on workflow automation, digital forms, repository-driven business logic, and enterprise integrations that help transform manual processes into secure, scalable, and auditable digital services.

This position requires strong experience in C#, .NET, API-based integrations, and Laserfiche Forms / Workflow design, with the ability to convert business requirements into technical solutions. The successful candidate will work closely with business analysts, administrators, records teams, and client stakeholders to deliver robust and supportable ECM capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Laserfiche Forms solutions for service requests, approvals, case management, onboarding, procurement, correspondence, and other digital workflows.
Build and optimize Laserfiche Workflow automations, including routing rules, escalations, notifications, approvals, metadata updates, SLA monitoring, and exception handling.
Develop C# / .NET integrations between Laserfiche and external enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, HRMS, email platforms, portals, identity services, and payment systems.
Implement API-based integrations using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, webhooks, or middleware patterns as required by the target architecture.
Translate business requirements into technical design documents, process maps, field structures, form logic, template usage, metadata models, and repository automation rules.
Support document capture and ingestion use cases, including imports, metadata assignment, validation rules, OCR-enabled processing, and structured content classification.
Prepare technical specifications, solution design documents, deployment plans, unit test cases, and release notes for each implemented solution.
Participate in sprint planning, solution walkthroughs, UAT support, hypercare, and production issue resolution activities.
Troubleshoot workflow failures, integration errors, performance bottlenecks, and form logic defects across development, test, and production environments.
Ensure that developed solutions comply with repository security rules, audit requirements, naming standards, and records governance principles.
Collaborate with administrators to align application behavior with access rights, roles, authentication methods, and platform constraints.
Contribute to reusable components, coding standards, and best practices for Laserfiche implementation within the project team.

Required Skills & Experience

Mandatory

Minimum 10 years of experience in enterprise application development or ECM/BPM solution delivery.
Minimum 4 years of hands-on Laserfiche development experience, including Forms and Workflow.
Strong programming experience in C#, .NET / .NET Core, and SQL.
Experience in designing and consuming APIs and integrating with third-party systems.
Ability to prepare technical documentation and support UAT / production deployment activities.
Good understanding of repository metadata, templates, field structures, and search-friendly information architecture.
Professional proficiency in English; Arabic is highly desirable.

Preferred / Nice to Have

Laserfiche Cloud experience
Experience in banking/government sectors
CI/CD tools exposure
Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, OCI)
Laserfiche certifications

Technical Stack / Tools

Laserfiche Forms / Business Processes
Laserfiche Workflow / Process Automation
C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET
REST / SOAP APIs, JSON, XML, web services
SQL Server, stored procedures, query optimization
JavaScript, HTML, CSS for form behavior and UI enhancement
Windows Server, IIS, Active Directory / SSO integration
Source control, test case management, and structured release procedures

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented Senior Engineer - Technology Quality Assurance to take complete ownership of our end-to-end testing lifecycle. In this role, you will be the ultimate champion for software quality, ensuring every feature we release meets exceptional standards of functional precision, performance, and user experience.

As a primary quality representative, you will also interface directly with clients to understand feedback and demonstrate product updates. If you have a sharp eye for a polished product, fluent communication skills, and deep expertise across manual, automated, and performance testing, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Complete QA Ownership: Lead and execute the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) from initial requirement analysis and test planning to release sign-off and post-launch monitoring.
Automation Framework Design: Own, Build, maintain, and scale robust automated test suites (UI and API) to accelerate integration and regression testing cycles.
Performance & Load Testing: Plan, script, and execute load, stress, and performance tests to ensure systems remain fast, scalable, and resilient under heavy traffic.
Manual & Exploratory Testing: Conduct thorough manual and exploratory testing to catch edge cases, usability flaws, and visual inconsistencies that automated scripts miss.
Product Polish Advocate: Serve as the ultimate filter for product quality, ensuring UI/UX flows are intuitive, seamless, and pixel-perfect prior to release.
Agile Integration: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and Designers in an Agile/Scrum environment to refine user stories, define acceptance criteria, and prevent defects early in the sprint cycle.
Defect Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track bugs to resolution using JIRA (or similar tools), providing clear reproduction steps and detailed diagnostics.
CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites directly into CI/CD deployment pipelines to enable continuous feedback and rapid delivery cycles.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience as a QA Engineer working on web and mobile applications.
Must have exceptional, highly competent verbal and written English skills for clear documentation, team collaboration, and professional client interactions.
Proven experience designing and implementing automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or similar.
Solid background in performance testing tools like JMeter, K6, or Gatling.
Strong expertise across manual, API (REST/GraphQL via Postman or RestAssured), cross-browser, and performance testing methodologies.
Extensive experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with active participation in sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives.
An exceptional eye for detail with a relentless drive to ensure products look, feel, and function flawlessly.
Comfortable writing SQL queries for database verification, inspecting network calls, and analyzing system logs.
Confident and willing to engage directly with clients and stakeholders as needed.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience presenting technical demos or managing UAT sessions with client stakeholders.
Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
Familiarity with security testing practices and OWASP principles.
ISTQB certification or equivalent software testing credential.

Our Benefits & Perks

Competitive compensation packages and comprehensive medical insurance to support you and your family.
Wellbeing-focused initiatives and resources, designed to enhance your personal and professional life.
Access to exclusive discount programs, offering savings across various lifestyle and leisure experiences across the UAE.

What Makes a Great Fit

If you are performance-driven and possess an inquisitive mind with the agility to navigate ambiguity, you will thrive here. At the heart of the Space42 community is a bias for action and a passion for developing innovative, efficient space services through AI-driven smart solutions that drive technological advancements and create a better tomorrow.

new_jobs.title: Software-ingenieur
new_jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Stratech Perspectief naar OutSystems

We zijn volop bezig met de migratie van Stratech Perspectief naar onze nieuwe webapplicatie in OutSystems. De basis staat en steeds meer functionaliteit krijgt een plek in de nieuwe omgeving. Voor deze fase zoeken we een ervaren Software Engineer OutSystems die ons Developmentteam komt versterken.

Stratech Perspectief is ons cliëntvolgsysteem voor onder andere schuldhulpverlening en budgetbeheer. Achter onze software zitten complexe processen, veranderende wet- en regelgeving en koppelingen met verschillende landelijke voorzieningen. Je werkt dus aan software die technisch interessant en inhoudelijk uitdagend is én dagelijks wordt gebruikt in het sociaal-financiële domein.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Software Engineer word je onderdeel van het Developmentteam van onze business unit Social. Samen werken jullie op een Agile manier aan de verdere ontwikkeling en migratie van Stratech Perspectief. Je ontwikkelt en verbetert functionaliteit in OutSystems en speelt een actieve rol in de migratie. Daarbij analyseer je bestaande processen en functionaliteit en vertaal je deze naar passende oplossingen binnen de nieuwe applicatie. Je kijkt verder dan alleen wat er nu staat en denkt mee over hoe we onze software slimmer, eenvoudiger en toekomstbestendiger kunnen inrichten. Technische vraagstukken zijn er genoeg. Je krijgt te maken met businesslogica, verschillende gegevensstromen en integraties met onder andere landelijke voorzieningen, documentmanagementsystemen en zaaksystemen. Daarbij denk je mee over technische oplossingen, kwaliteit en de onderhoudbaarheid van onze software.

Onze markt staat bovendien nooit stil. Nieuwe initiatieven, wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving en koppelingen moeten hun weg vinden naar onze software. Dat vraagt om een Software Engineer die graag de inhoud induikt, technische vraagstukken doorgrondt en samen met collega's tot goede oplossingen komt.

Software bouwen doen we samen

Bij Stratech krijg je niet simpelweg een lijst met tickets die je zelfstandig moet wegwerken. Je wordt onderdeel van een Developmentteam waarin we kennis delen, technische keuzes bespreken en samen verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor het resultaat. Je werkt nauw samen met andere Developers en brengt jouw eigen kennis en ervaring met OutSystems mee. Andersom nemen jouw collega's je mee in Stratech Perspectief Cloud en het sociaal-financiële domein. Zo combineren we technische expertise met de jarenlange product- en marktkennis die binnen Stratech aanwezig is.

Ook buiten Development zoeken we nadrukkelijk de samenwerking. Consultants weten wat er bij onze klanten speelt, de Servicedesk ziet waar gebruikers in de dagelijkse praktijk tegenaan lopen en andere specialisten brengen hun eigen expertise mee. Die verschillende perspectieven gebruiken we om onze software beter te maken. Kom je ergens niet uit? Dan zoeken we samen naar een oplossing. Zie jij juist een mogelijkheid om iets slimmer of beter te doen? Dan verwachten we dat je die deelt.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken een Software Engineer die nieuwsgierig is, initiatief neemt en graag samenwerkt. Iemand die niet alleen bouwt wat er gevraagd wordt maar ook nadenkt over hoe iets beter kan.

Daarnaast heb je:
WO werk- en denkniveau bijvoorbeeld op gebied van Software Engineering, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting
Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling in OutSystems
Affiniteit met het ontwikkelen van moderne webapplicaties
Een sterk analytisch vermogen en het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar passende technische oplossingen
Ervaring met of kennis van .NET is mooi meegenomen
Een proactieve houding en de nieuwsgierigheid om de mogelijkheden binnen OutSystems optimaal te benutten
Plezier in samenwerken, kennis delen en samen tot goede oplossingen te komen

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Werken bij Stratech betekent verantwoordelijkheid krijgen én de ruimte om met jouw kennis en ideeën bij te dragen. We werken graag samen, zoeken elkaar gemakkelijk op en geloven dat juist het directe contact met collega's helpt om sneller tot goede oplossingen te komen.
Daarom werken we voornamelijk vanuit ons kantoor in Enschede. Zeker binnen de migratie van Stratech Perspectief vinden we het belangrijk dat Developers gemakkelijk kunnen schakelen, samen achter een vraagstuk kunnen duiken en kennis met elkaar delen.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:
Een goed salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring
27 vakantiedagen
Een goede pensioenregeling
Een dienstverband van 36-40 uur per week
Een deskundig team waarin kennis delen vanzelfsprekend is
Een informele werkomgeving met ruimte voor verantwoordelijkheid, ideeën en plezier
Elke vrijdag om 16:30 uur: laptops dicht & borrel
Leuke teamactiviteiten en uitjes met je directe collega's én de rest van Stratech

Goed om te weten

Voor deze fase van de migratie zoeken we in eerste instantie versterking voor een periode van ongeveer zes maanden. Gedurende die periode ben je volwaardig onderdeel van het Developmentteam en werk je samen met je collega's aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Stratech Perspectief Cloud.

Voor deze functie staan we open voor zowel kandidaten die bij ons in dienst willen komen als zelfstandig professionals (zzp'ers). Omdat we voor deze fase van de migratie in eerste instantie versterking zoeken voor een periode van zes maanden, bespreken we graag welke vorm het beste past.

We komen graag rechtstreeks in contact met kandidaten en zzp'ers. Acquisitie of bemiddeling van een recruitment-, detachering- en andere bureaus naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen we niet op prijs.

Over Stratech

Stratech ontwikkelt kennisintensieve software voor nichemarkten. We combineren technologie met diepgaande kennis van de markten waarin onze klanten actief zijn. Daardoor zijn we meer dan alleen een softwareleverancier: we begrijpen de processen achter onze software en denken actief met onze klanten mee.

Binnen onze business unit Social ontwikkelen we software voor de gemeentelijke markt. Met Stratech Perspectief Cloud ondersteunen we professionals bij onder andere schuldhulpverlening en budgetbeheer.

Daarmee werk je aan software die technisch interessant is én een duidelijke plek heeft in de dagelijkse praktijk van onze klanten.

Bouw jij met ons mee?

Heb jij ervaring met OutSystems en zoek je een omgeving waarin je niet alleen functionaliteit bouwt maar ook kunt meedenken over technische oplossingen en de verdere ontwikkeling van een volwassen softwareproduct? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Do you want to help clients unlock the value of automation, AI and low-code innovation? At Avanade, you’ll have the opportunity to design, build and deliver intelligent Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio solutions that improve how organisations work.

We are seeking a hands-on Power Platform Engineer to help establish and grow Power Platform capability for our clients, with a focus on Copilot Studio, automation, multi-agent solutions, apps, Dataverse and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical delivery experience with curiosity for emerging AI capabilities, practical knowledge of Power Platform and the confidence to work directly with business and technical stakeholders.

You will join a collaborative community of Microsoft specialists, engineers and consultants who are helping clients modernise processes, improve productivity and adopt AI responsibly.

About The Role

Avanade is the leading expert on Microsoft technologies. By joining Avanades UKDC , you will have a fantastic opportunity to operate at the forefront of technology, with access to the best clients across the world, working on challenging and exciting services.

We are a diverse team, and we are proud of our culture that welcomes every individual. In our teams you will find talented and passionate technologists, with a humble, collaborative, and positive attitude. We promise to invest in you and help give you the platform for continuous learning and development.

As a Power Platform Engineer, you will design and implement end-to-end Copilot Studio and Power Platform solutions that enable automation, intelligent assistance and process improvement for clients.

The role combines solution design, hands-on development, stakeholder engagement, requirements analysis, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

You will work across the full solution lifecycle—from discovery and requirements capture through to development, deployment, adoption, optimization and upskilling.

Key Responsibilities

In This Role, You Will:

Establish and grow client Power Platform capabilities, enabling powerful automation and AI functions across business teams.
Design and implement end-to-end Copilot Studio and Power Platform solutions, including automation and AI-enabled capabilities.

Vill du hjälpa till att forma framtiden för AI-drivet arbete? new_jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Pensions and Spend
new_jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer - Investments

About Kota

Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products - Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution - we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.

Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

The role & team

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.

The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.

On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

What You'll Do

Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
Contribute to frontend code (React + TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
Use AI actively in your day-to-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

What We're Looking For

6+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs
Strong understanding of data modelling, event-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast-growing startup
AI-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

Why join us?

Technically interesting problem - pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised
Modern stack - .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event-driven
Agency - we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
Customer proximity - you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it
High-quality culture - we care about clean design and thoughtful engineering
Impact from day one - we're a small, focused team. What you build ships fast and matters
AI-first - we invest heavily in AI tooling and token usage. We're not precious about the spend, if it helps you build better or faster, use it

Our hiring process

Introductory call (30 mins): a casual chat with one or two of our product team
Technical interview (90 mins): a collaborative, open-book session with two engineers, working through a real-world problem together
Call with founders (30 mins): we'll share our vision and hear your thoughts
Final response: we'll follow up promptly with next steps

Kota Benefits

Health insurance via Kota
Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
WFH stipend to support your home office setup
Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
Access to office space in Dublin or a co-working space, wherever you're based
Flexible working hours, we're remote-first with some fixed hours for team alignment

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

new_jobs.title: AI Developer
new_jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI Developer to our team in Espoo or Tampere!

This permanent position is about building AI solutions that do real work in our customers' processes, and making them reliable enough to run in production. The role can be tailored according to your preferences and skills: some of our developers spend more time with the customer shaping which processes are worth automating, others go deeper into the orchestration, evaluation and operations side.

You will join a team of experienced professionals from different areas of software expertise. We work in a hybrid mode, but in this role we expect strong presence in Espoo or Tampere.

Naturally, you will have access to modern tools and strong co-operation with your colleagues.

One of our strengths in career development is our diverse range of clients and various projects in different fields. That enables us to offer versatile opportunities for our employees. At Etteplan, we are concentrating on helping our customers especially in industrial system digitalization, which means the agents you build will touch engineering data, technical documentation, service processes and industrial operations, not just chat interfaces. Many of these customers have strict requirements about where their data may go, so running models locally and on-premises is a direction we are actively building capability in.

As an AI Developer at Etteplan, the role would include (but not be limited to):

Map customer processes into agentic workflows: decide what the agent decides, what a tool does, and where a human stays in the loop
Design and build tool-using agents that plan and execute multi-step tasks, including task decomposition, state and memory handling, and controlled autonomy
Build and maintain the tool and integration layer: tool contracts and schemas, structured input and output, validation and retries, and connections to customer APIs, databases, document repositories and operational systems
Build the application around the agent, from the user-facing interface to backend services, databases, authentication and deployment pipelines
Deploy solutions where the customer needs them, whether that is Azure, another cloud, the customer's own servers, or an on-premises environment running local models
Implement the controls that make AI acceptable in an industrial context: permissions, policy checks, audit logs, and correct handling of confidential customer data
Stay up to date with the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and help us decide what is production-ready and what is not

We are looking for a person who has:

Proven experience building LLM-based applications that reached production, not only prototypes and demos
Hands-on experience with agent frameworks and orchestration, for example LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Semantic Kernel, Copilot Studio, n8n or equivalent
Experience working against AI and LLM APIs from several providers, including tool and function calling, structured output, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) or comparable ways of exposing tools and data to an agent
Full-stack capability: you can take a solution from user interface through backend services, databases, APIs and authentication to a running deployment
Docker and containers as part of your normal way of working, together with CI/CD and monitoring
Familiarity with cloud platforms, Azure in particular, and with AWS or Google Cloud as a plus
Ability to work directly with customers, translate ambiguous requirements into something buildable, and explain trade-offs in plain language
Working proficiency in English; Finnish is a strong advantage in customer work

We appreciate also, if you are familiar with:

Local and self-hosted inference
Efficient handling of large volumes of data
Evaluation of non-deterministic systems
Industrial context: manufacturing, energy, machinery, medical devices or defence and security, and the systems around them such as MES, PLM, ERP, IIoT or technical documentation and CCMS environments

The salary range is quite wide, reflecting our openness to both earlier‑career and more experienced professionals. What matters most to us is finding the right competencies and fit and aligning the role and compensation to match.

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect (m/v/x)  - Lemon 🍋
new_jobs.description:
Over de Rol

Bij Lemon 🍋 geloven we dat de beste software oplossingen voortvloeien uit diverse perspectieven. Ben jij de Solution Architect
die de vertaalslag kan maken van complexe business behoeften naar robuuste, technische ontwerpen? Je bent de drijvende kracht achter de technische roadmap van onze klantoplossingen en zorgt voor de harmonie tussen verschillende systemen en technologieën. Je werkt op het snijvlak van business, analyse en ontwikkeling.

Jouw bijdrage

Wij zoeken iemand die een proactieve rol wil spelen:

Analyse van de business vereisten en deze vertalen naar gedetailleerde, schaalbare architecturale blauwdrukken en ontwerpen.
Definiëren van de technische componenten, integraties en standaarden die nodig zijn om de oplossing te bouwen en te onderhouden.
Fungeren als technisch adviseur voor klanten en development teams, en hen begeleiden bij de implementatie.
Proactief risico’s identificeren met betrekking tot de technische keuzes en architectuur, en mitigerende strategieën voorstellen.
Zorgen voor naleving van architecturale best practices, security standaarden en performance vereisten.
Actief kennis delen tijdens lunch & learns en collegiale feedback geven via peer reviews, code en architectuurreviews.
Op de hoogte blijven van en de adoptie van de nieuwste architecturale patronen, cloud technologieën en development frameworks sturen.

Welke kwaliteiten breng je mee?

Gericht op competenties en potentieel, moedigen we je aan om te solliciteren als je denkt dat je voldoende vaardigheden bezit.

Essentiële Vaardigheden

Bewezen ervaring in het ontwerpen en leveren van end-to-end software oplossingen, van concept tot productie.
Diepgaande kennis van architecturale patronen (zoals Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture) en expertise in cloudplatformen (bv. AWS, Azure, GCP).
Het vermogen om business requirements te interpreteren en technische complexiteit te reduceren tot heldere ontwerpen.
Uitmuntende communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Je kunt zowel met ontwikkelaars als met C-level stakeholders spreken.
Ervaring met verschillende database technologieën en integratiemethoden.

Aanbevolen opleiding & ervaring 🎓

Een academische achtergrond in Computer Science, Software Engineering, of een gerelateerd studiegebied. Master niveau is een sterke troef.
Doorgaans 7+ jaar ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, waarvan liefst 3 jaar in een architectuur- of leidende technische rol.
Certificeringen in relevante cloud- of architectuur zijn een pluspunt.

Wat we je bieden

Bij Lemon🍋 streven we naar een werkplek waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig en gewaardeerd voelt:

Waarden: We moedigen een cultuur van respect en open dialoog aan.
Flexibiliteit: flexibele werkuren en de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerk om een gezonde balans te ondersteunen.
Ontwikkeling: De Lemon Academy 🏫 staat centraal voor kennisdeling, mentorschap en voortdurende persoonlijke groei.
Inclusiviteit: We ondersteunen redelijke aanpassingen in de werkomgeving of - processen zodat jij optimaal kan functioneren.
Compensatie: Een all-in salaris pakket dat meegroeit met jouw impact. Dit omvat een flexibel verloningsplan, maaltijdcheques, bedrijfswagen met tankkaart, een performante laptop en een comfortabel gsm-abonnement.
Zorg & Welzijn: Een uitgebreide hospitalisatieverzekering en een ambulante verzekering die een breed scala aan medische kosten dekt.
Events: Vrijblijvende sociale momenten en teamactiviteiten die openstaan voor ieders voorkeur; zoals onze jaarlijkse skireis, de zomer-bbq, onze Lemon-running-group, een wederkerend padeltoernooi, en nog zoveel meer. Geheel divers, maar allemaal onvergetelijk!

Solliciteren bij 🍋

Herken jij jezelf in deze beschrijving? Dan horen we heel graag van je!

Twijfel je of je over voldoende kwalificaties beschikt? Solliciteer dan toch! Als je een passie voor softwareontwikkeling en een leergierige mindset hebt, zijn we benieuwd waarom je bij Lemon wil werken.

Lemon is een gelijke kansen werkgever. We behandelen alle sollicitaties vertrouwelijk en op basis van competenties.
